field_report: On the owner's ZimaOS the update failed because the stored app configuration had a memory reservation (256 MB) above the memory limit (128 MB); Docker rejects such containers, so 'Recreate' aborted and v0.2.7 kept running. Documented in the README. After the fix the update worked; the installed phone PWA then showed a blank screen, which the start-up guard now turns into a visible error with a repair action.
